summary: Iteration 7 — first/last name fields + Make/Model dropdowns + 3 document uploads on driver signup. Backend (6/6 pytest) and frontend (driver signup flow + admin doc chips) all pass. New driver lands on /(driver) home with 'Pending' badge and 'Application under review' card. Admin /admin Users tab shows License/Insurance/Registration chips for the new driver with Approve/Decline. expo-document-picker (web) opens a file chooser; tested with both JPEG and PDF. No critical or minor issues found in the new flow.
action_items: Optional (not blocking): Expo prints a compatibility warning about expo@54.0.34 (expected ~54.0.35), expo-font@14.0.11, expo-router@6.0.23. Consider `npx expo install --check` to align package versions when convenient.

Optional minor: React Native web warnings 'shadow* style props are deprecated' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' surface in the console — sourced from upstream libs/older shadow style usage; not blocking but worth a sweep.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: register correctly persists first_name/last_name/license_doc/insurance_doc/registration_doc on driver only and forces approval_status='pending'. public_user does not expose docs, which is correct (admin /admin/users returns the full doc fields via direct projection, as required).
DocumentField client-side validates MIME (jpeg/png/pdf) and size <= 8MB and stores base64 dataUrl — clean.
SelectField: resetting model when make changes is handled in auth.tsx via setVehicleModel("") in the Make onSelect — works as verified.
seed_data_creation: Created two pending drivers as part of testing: docdriver+k05ftz@getaride.com (via UI signup, Toyota Camry, Silver, FL K05, GEICO, all 3 docs) and docdriver+321c641b@getaride.com (via backend API, then admin-approved; left approved for downstream tests). Both visible in admin Users tab. Passwords: Drive1234.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tests for this iteration live in /app/backend/tests/test_driver_docs_signup.py and cover: driver register with first/last/docs returning pending, /auth/me + /auth/login preserving pending, pending-blocked online (403), admin /admin/users returning the docs, admin approve unblocks /driver/online. Frontend Playwright flow: switch to signup → role=driver → step 0 (first-name-input, last-name-input, email-input, password-input, phone-input) → step 1 (make-select then model-select, year/color/plate) → step 2 (license-input, insurance-input + three DocumentField uploads via page.expect_file_chooser on testIDs license-doc / insurance-doc / registration-doc; verify <id>-filled). Submitting w/o all 3 docs surfaces auth-error 'Please upload your license, insurance and registration documents.'. Approve/Decline buttons in admin Users live next to each pending driver row.
